✅ Those 8,412 files are NOT 25 GB.
They are:
8,412 files that are each under 20–25 MB.
Not “8,412 gigabytes.”
Not “8,412 files totaling 25 GB.”
The script filtered with this rule:
arduinoCopy code-size -20M

Meaning:

“Only scan files smaller than 20 MB.”

So every one of those 8,412 duplicates is:

less than 20 MB

most likely WAY smaller (usually kilobytes)

often tiny junk files
